novelty: Replace O3's supplied exact operators with online query-blind learned intervention input/output relationships and exact version-space uncertainty.
hypothesis: Six-parameter trained causal role encoder plus proof-preserving counterfactual composition can recover unknown binary causal laws from authenticated randomized interventions, abstain whenever incomplete, and fit within bounded memory; any tie to equally-informed symbolic version space is not a learned gain.
public_inputs: 12-step causal role program with three recurrent role identities (public schematic) and public intervention-assigned input/output evidence; no actual operator identities passed to candidate.
learning: For each of 3 roles and 2 binary input values, update one signed coordinate from randomized-intervention label. Zero=unseen, -1=observed zero, +1=observed one. Unknown/conflict fail closed.
certificate: Independently enumerate every combination of full unary Boolean operators consistent with observed public pairs; certify a composed answer if and only if all possibilities agree.
controls: independent exact symbolic version-space control same observations
tests: all 4^3 operator triplets by 2^3 first intervention inputs on 6 public programs and both initial values
two distinct randomized intervention inputs identify an arbitrary unary Boolean law per role
incomplete pair can never justify a counterfactual when public-consistent worlds disagree
contradictory public data, observational data alone, unsupported roles and malformed programs fail closed
zero false positives and exact symbolic equivalence
resources: Six signed learned coordinates and proof masks explicitly counted. Whole native CPU/RSS parity is NOT established by feasibility; must measure complete training/inference in prospective research.
next: New independent first-use families, contextual trainable encoding, query-blind future value, learned compositional program with strongest trained recurrent/relational/symbolic controls and component ablations.
